semantics.function: For every integer i from 0 through 99, out[i] = in[99-i].
semantics.timing: Purely combinational; output tracks current input after combinational settling, with no clock-cycle latency.
semantics.initialization: No stored state or initialization requirement.
semantics.transactions: No handshake; all input bit patterns are valid.

numeric.operation: Bit permutation only; no arithmetic, rounding, truncation, saturation, overflow, or sign extension.
numeric.bit_order: Input bit 99 maps to output bit 0; input bit 0 maps to output bit 99.
numeric.four_state: Direct wiring preserves each source bit value, including X and Z in simulation.

verification.oracle: Build expected vector by iterating source indices downward and shifting bits into a separate reference vector.
verification.directed: All zero, all one, alternating patterns, each of 100 walking-one and walking-zero positions.
verification.four_state: Mixed X/Z pattern checked with case inequality.
verification.timing: Change inputs repeatedly and compare after a finite settling delay; no clock or reset.
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12, -g2012, explicit dev_tb top; finite timeout on compile and simulation.
